spans.s: स्तक् vt. 1P (pres. स्तकति) 1. To resist; 2. to strike against, to repel.

स्तन् vi. 1P, 10U (pp. स्तनित; pres. स्तनति, स्तनयति-ते) 1. To sound, to make a sound, to reverberate; 2. to groan, to breathe hard, to sigh; 3. to thunder, to roar aloud, तस्तनुर्जज्वलुर्मम्लुर्जग्लुर्लुलुठिरे क्षताः Bt.xiv.30.With नि-, 1. to sigh; 2. to bewail.
स्तन m. 1. The female breast, मध्ये श्यामः स्तन इव भुवः शेषविस्तारपांडुः Megh.i.18; 2. an udder or dug of any female animal, अर्धपीतस्तनं मातुरामर्दक्लिष्टकेशरम् Sak.vii.
स्तन-अंशुक n. a cloth covering the bosom.
स्तन-अग्र m. a nipple.
स्तन-अंगराग m. paint or pigment on the breasts of women.
स्तन-अंतर n. 1. the heart; 2. the space between the two breasts, विभ्रत्या कौस्तुभन्यासं स्तनांतरविलंबिनम् R.x.62; 3. a mark on the breast (supposed to indicate future widowhood).
स्तन-आभोग m. 1. fullness of the breast; 2. the circumference or orb of the breast; 3. a man with large breasts like those of a woman.
स्तन-तट m.n. the slope of the breasts.
स्तनंधय (I) a. (f. यी) sucking at the breast, तवांकशायी परिवृत्तभाग्यया मया न दृष्टस्तनयः स्तनंधयः M.M.x.
स्तनंधय (II) m. an infant, a suckling.
स्तनंधय (I) a. (f. यी) sucking at the breast, तवांकशायी परिवृत्तभाग्यया मया न दृष्टस्तनयः स्तनंधयः M.M.x.
स्तन-प a. (f. पा) sucking at the breast.
स्तन-प a. (f. पा) sucking at the breast.
स्तन-पान n. sucking of the breast.
स्तन-भर m. 1. a man with breasts like a woman’s; 2. heaviness or bulk of the female breasts, मुहुः स्तनभरेणानीतया नम्रताम् Rat.i.
स्तन-मुख, -वृंत न्।, -शिखा ऋ। n. a nipple.
स्तन-मुख, -वृंत न्।, -शिखा ऋ। n. a nipple.
स्तन-शिखा f. a nipple.
स्तनन n. 1. Sounding, sound, noise; 2. the rumbling of clouds; 3. groaning; 4. breathing hard.
स्तनयित्नु m. 1. Thundering, thunder, the muttering of clouds; 2. a cloud; 3. lightning; 4. sickness; 5. death; 6. a kind of grass.
स्तनित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Sounded, sounding; 2. thundering.
स्तनित (II) n. 1. The rattling of thunder, rumbling of thundering clouds, जीमूतस्तनितविशंकिभिर्मयूरैः Mal.i.; 2. thunder, noise; 3. the noise made by clapping the hands.
स्तनित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Sounded, sounding; 2. thundering.
स्तन्य n. Mother’s milk, milk.
स्तन्य-त्याग m. leaving off the mother’s milk, weaning, स्तन्यत्यागात्प्रभृति सुमुखी दंतपांचालिकेव M.M.x., पिब स्तन्यं पोत Bh.V.i.60.
स्तबक m. Bunch, cluster, हस्तप्राप्यस्तबकनमितो बालमंदारवृक्षः Megh.ii.12, K.S.iii.39, R.xiii.32.

स्तब्ध a. (f. ब्धा) 1. Fixed, firm, hard; 2. numb, paralysed, senseless, stupefied; 3. stiff, rigid, immovable; 4. stopped, brought to a stop, blocked up; 5. obstinate, stubborn, hard-hearted; 6. coarse.

स्तब्ध a. (f. ब्धा) 1. Fixed, firm, hard; 2. numb, paralysed, senseless, stupefied; 3. stiff, rigid, immovable; 4. stopped, brought to a stop, blocked up; 5. obstinate, stubborn, hard-hearted; 6. coarse.
स्तब्ध-कर्ण a. pricking up the ears.
स्तब्ध-ता f. rigidity, stupor, stubborness.
स्तब्ध-त्व n. rigidity, stupor, stubborness.
स्तब्ध-रोमन् m. a boar, a hog.
स्तब्ध-लोचन a. having fixed or unwinking eyes (as an epithet of gods).
स्तब्धि f. 1. Fixedness, hardness, rigidity; 2. firmness, immobility; 3. stupor, numbness; 4. obstinacy.
स्तभ् vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. स्तंभते) See स्तंभ्.
स्तभ m. A goat, a ram.
स्तभु n. The same as स्तंभन q.v.
स्तम् vi. 1P (pres. स्तमति) To be confused or agitated.

स्तंब m. 1. A clump of grass, R.v.15; 2. a sheaf of corn, न शालेः स्तंबकरिता वप्तुर्गुणमापेक्षते Mud.i.; 3. a clump or bunch in general; 4. a bush, a thicket; 5. a shrub or plant having no decided stem; 6. the post to which an elephant is tied; 7. stupefaction, insensibility; (probably for स्तंभ in this sense.); 8. a mountain.
स्तंब-करि (I) a. forming into clusters.
स्तंब-करि (II) m. corn, rice.
स्तंब-करि˚ता f. luxuriant growth, the state of thickening into sheaves or clusters, न शालेः स्तंबकरिता वप्तुर्गुणमापेक्षते Mud.i.
स्तंब-घन m. 1. a small hoe for weeding clumps of grass, a sickle for cutting corn; 2. a basket for holding the heads of wild rice.
स्तंब-घ्न m. a sickle for cutting corn.
स्तंबेरम m. an elephant, स्तंबेरमा मुखरशृंखलकर्षिणस्ते R.v.82.

स्तंभ् vt. or vi. 1Ā, 5P, 9P (the initial स् of this root is changed into ष् after अव or any preposition ending in इ or उ) (pp. स्तंभित or स्तब्ध; pres. स्तंभते, स्तभ्नोति, स्तभ्नाति) 1. To fix firmly, to make stiff or immovable; 2. to paralyze, to stupefy, प्राणा दध्वंसिरे गात्रं तस्तम्भे च प्रिये हते Bt.xvi.55; 3. to prop, to support, to sustain; 4. to stop, to arrest, to suppress, to hinder, कंठः स्तंभितबाष्पवृत्तिकलुषः Sak.iv.; 5. to become stiff or haughty, e.g. स्तंभते पुरुषः प्रायो यौवनेन धनेन च.With अव-, 1. to bind; 2. to rest on, to rely on; 3. to restrain, to overpower, प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि औनः पुनः Bg.ix.8.With उद्-, 1. to uphold, to prop; 2. to stop, to arrest.With नि-, to stop.With पर्यव-, 1. to surround; 2. to surround and oppose.With वि-, to fix, to plant immovably, अत्युच्छ्रिते मंत्रिणि पार्थिवे च विष्टभ्य पादावुपतिष्ठते Mud.iv.With सम्-, 1. to support; 2. to stop, प्रयत्नसंस्तंभितविक्रियाणां कथंचिदीशा मनसां बभूवुः K.S.iii.34; 3. to corroborate, to make firm or immovable, एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्या संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना Bg.iii.43.With समव-, to encourage.

स्तंभ m. 1. Fixedness, stiffness, rigidity, गात्रस्तंभः स्तनमुकुलयोरुत्प्रबंधः प्रकंपः M.M.ii.; 2. prop, support, fulcrum; 3. insensibility, stupor, paralysis; 4. stupidity; 5. want of feeling or excitability; 6. stoppage, obstruction, hindrance, सोऽपश्यत्प्रणिधानेन संततेः स्तंभकारणम् R.i.74; 7. a pillar, a column, a post, e.g. तैः स्तंभैरिव सुस्थिरैश्चिरभरक्लांतां धरा धार्यते; 8. immobility, motionlessnes, तत्संकल्पोऽपहितजडिम स्तंभमभ्येति गात्रम् M.M.i.; 9. suppression or arresting of any force or feeling by magical means; 10. suppressing, curbing, restraining, कृतश्चित्तस्तंभः प्रतिहतधियामंजलिरपि Bhartr.iii.6.
स्तंभ-उत्कीर्ण a. carved out of a post of wood (as a statue).
स्तंभ-कर (I) a. 1. paralyzing; 2. obstructing.
स्तंभ-कर (II) m. a fence.
स्तंभ-करण n. cause of obstruction or impediment.
स्तंभ-पूजा f. worship of the posts of the temporary pavilions erected for marriages or other festive occasions.
स्तंभकिन् m. A kind of musical instrument covered with leather.

स्तंभन (I) n. 1. The act of fixing firmly or making stiff; 2. paralyzing, stunning, benumbing; 3. propping, supporting; 4. stopping, hindering, arresting, suppressing, checking, लोलोल्लोलक्षुभितकरुणोज्जृंभणस्तंभनार्थम् Ut.iii.; 5. stopping the flow of blood; 6. anything employed as an astringent; 7. a particular magical act or faculty.
स्तंभन (II) m. An epithet of one of the fire arrows of Kāmadeva.
स्तर (I) a. (f. रा) Spreading, extending, covering.
स्तर (II) n. 1. Anything spread, a layer, a stratum; 2. a bed.
स्तर (I) a. (f. रा) Spreading, extending, covering.
स्तरण n. The act of spreading or strewing.
स्तरि(री)मन् m. A bed, a couch.
स्तरि(री)मन् m. A bed, a couch.
स्तरी f. 1. Smoke, vapour; 2. a heifer; 3. a barren cow.
स्तव m. 1. Praising, celebrating, hymning; 2. praise, eulogium, panegyric.
स्ताव m. Praise.
स्तवक (I) a. (f. विका) Praising, eulogizing.
स्तवक (II) m. 1. A panegyrist, a praiser; 2. praise, eulogium; 3. a cluster of blossoms; 4. a nosegay, tuft; 5. the chapter of a book, (e.g. of the Lakṣmīsahasra).
स्तावक m. Praiser, panegyrist, flatterer.
स्तवक (I) a. (f. विका) Praising, eulogizing.
स्तवन n. 1. Praising, praise; 2. a hymn.
